name: Henry II the Lion
note: work list has Henry I the Pilgrim (source: reign 1264-1271, ruled probably only de jure in 1298; died 1302); regency of Anastasia of Pomerania

name: Albert IV
note: co-ruler (part 1); part 1 then divided between parts 2 and 3

name: Henry IV the Fat
note: part 3 until 1423, then all parts; co-ruler with John V until 1442

name: Henry V the Peaceful
note: Schwerin line (Güstrow line of his brother Albert VII not included)

name: Philip
note: Duchy of Schwerin; mentally disabled, regency of his cousin

name: Adolph Frederick I the Glorious
note: deposed by Emperor Ferdinand II 1628; duchy ruled by Albrecht von Wallenstein 1628-1631
